clips.title: The story
paras: The Lost Fleet consists of the shattered wooden hulks of the Kul Tiras Third Fleet, sunken off the northern coast of the Wetlands along Baradin Bay. Decimated during the Second War by Dragonmaw-enslaved red dragons, the wreckage is now haunted by restless, cursed undead sailors bound to the wreckage by a mysterious curse.

During the Second War, on its last voyage, the Kul Tiras Third Fleet was ambushed from above by red dragons enslaved by the Dragonmaw clan. Sheets of dragonflame quickly engulfed the fleet, sending proud vessels like the Wave Mistress and the Intrepid crashing onto the shallows and reefs of northern Bluegill Marsh. Almost the entire contingent drowned or burned, with First Mate Fitzsimmons standing as the lone living survivor of the disaster.
